rows.sql:
SELECT SUM(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS students_ages_5_17
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.EdOpsCode = 'SSS' AND s.City = 'Fremont' AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015';

SELECT s.City FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.EILCode = 'HS' AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Lunch Provision 2' AND f."Low Grade" = '9' AND f."High Grade" = '12' AND s.County = 'Merced';

WITH t AS (
  SELECT s.City AS city, COUNT(*) AS num_schools
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.GSserved = 'K-8' AND s.Magnet = 1
    AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types'
  GROUP BY s.City
)
SELECT city, num_schools, 0 AS ord FROM t
UNION ALL
SELECT 'TOTAL', SUM(num_schools), 1 FROM t
ORDER BY ord, num_schools DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND d.A3 = 'north Bohemia' AND d.A11 > 8000;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_clients_born_before_1950_in_sokolov FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01' AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov'
SELECT d.client_id FROM card c JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id WHERE c.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';
SELECT d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.loan_id = 4990

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count FROM account a JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND t.balance < 0;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS account_count FROM loan l JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE a.district_id = 1 AND l.status IN ('C', 'D')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT o.order_id, o.account_id, d.type AS disp_type, c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, c.district_id FROM "order" o JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = o.account_id JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE o.order_id = 32423;
SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date, substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS birth_year FROM client c WHERE c.client_id = 130;

WITH f AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, c.client_id, c.birth_date, d.A11
  FROM client c
  JOIN disp di ON di.client_id = c.client_id
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = di.account_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F'
)
SELECT DISTINCT account_id
FROM f
WHERE birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM f)
  AND A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM f WHERE birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM f));

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonds FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+'
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id IN (SELECT b.molecule_id FROM bond b WHERE b.bond_type = '=');
SELECT COUNT(*) AS triple_bond_count FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '#';
SELECT DISTINCT a.element FROM bond b JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id WHERE b.bond_type = '=';
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(b.bond_id) AS percent FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT a.atom_id, a.element FROM atom a WHERE a.atom_id IN (SELECT substr(bond_id, 1, instr(bond_id, '_') + length(substr(bond_id, instr(bond_id, '_') + 1, instr(substr(bond_id, instr(bond_id, '_') + 1), '_') - 1)) + 0) FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR144_8_19') OR a.atom_id IN ('TR144_8', 'TR144_19');
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-' LIMIT 50;
SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2 FROM connected c JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#' LIMIT 50;
SELECT molecule_id, label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR124';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'n'

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 's')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '=')
LIMIT 50;
SELECT id, name, setCode, cardKingdomId, cardKingdomFoilId FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL LIMIT 50;

WITH rc AS (
  SELECT c.uuid, c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo, COUNT(r.id) AS ruling_count
  FROM cards c
  JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
  GROUP BY c.uuid, c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo
)
SELECT name, artist, CASE WHEN isPromo = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_promo, ruling_count
FROM rc
WHERE ruling_count = (SELECT MAX(ruling_count) FROM rc);
SELECT DISTINCT type FROM cards WHERE name = 'Benalish Knight'
SELECT manaCost FROM cards WHERE layout = 'normal' AND frameVersion = '2003' AND borderColor = 'black' AND availability = 'mtgo,paper'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN isOnlineOnly = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(id) AS percentage FROM cards WHERE frameEffects = 'legendary';
SELECT st.language FROM sets s JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code WHERE s.block = 'Ravnica' AND s.baseSetSize = 180;
SELECT language FROM foreign_data WHERE multiverseid = 149934;

SELECT s.name, s.code, s.baseSetSize FROM sets s JOIN set_translations t ON t.setCode = s.code WHERE t.language = 'Russian' AND s.baseSetSize = (SELECT MAX(s2.baseSetSize) FROM sets s2 JOIN set_translations t2 ON t2.setCode = s2.code WHERE t2.language = 'Russian');
SELECT DISTINCT fd.language FROM foreign_data fd JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND fd.flavorText IS NOT NULL;
SELECT s.releaseDate FROM set_translations st JOIN sets s ON s.code = st.setCode WHERE st.translation = 'Ola de frío';
SELECT DISTINCT s.type, s.code, s.name FROM cards c JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code WHERE c.name = 'Samite Pilgrim';

SELECT frameEffects, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL AND frameEffects IS NOT NULL AND frameEffects != '' GROUP BY frameEffects ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT uuid FROM legalities WHERE format = 'oldschool' AND LOWER(status) IN ('banned', 'restricted');
SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users WHERE UpVotes > 100 AND DownVotes > 1;
SELECT u.DisplayName FROM votes v JOIN users u ON u.Id = v.UserId WHERE v.Id = 6347;
SELECT p.Id, p.Title, COUNT(v.Id) AS VoteCount FROM posts p LEFT JOIN votes v ON v.PostId = p.Id WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data visualization%' GROUP BY p.Id, p.Title;

WITH c AS (SELECT UserId, COUNT(Id) AS n FROM comments WHERE UserId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY UserId),
top AS (SELECT UserId, n FROM c WHERE n = (SELECT MAX(n) FROM c))
SELECT t.UserId, t.n AS comment_count,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT b.Name) AS badges
FROM top t LEFT JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = t.UserId
GROUP BY t.UserId, t.n
ORDER BY t.UserId;
rows.review: The query returns one row per badge instead of one row per user, because the LEFT JOIN to badges fans out the result. The question asks for the users with the most comments and their badges, so the badges should be aggregated per user (e.g., GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT b.Name) or a separate listing of distinct user-badge pairs with SELECT DISTINCT). Duplicate badge names such as "Announcer" and "Constituent" should also be deduplicated.

rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(Id) AS post_count FROM posts WHERE Score = 10;
SELECT Title FROM posts WHERE CreaionDate = (SELECT MIN(CreaionDate) FROM posts);

SELECT u.DisplayName, COUNT(b.Name) AS badge_count FROM badges b JOIN users u ON u.Id = b.UserId GROUP BY b.UserId HAVING COUNT(b.Name) = (SELECT MAX(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(Name) AS c FROM badges GROUP BY UserId));
SELECT MIN(p.CreaionDate) AS first_post_date FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.Age = (SELECT MIN(Age) FROM users);
SELECT COUNT(p.Id) AS post_count FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Jay Stevens' AND strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2010';
SELECT u.Reputation, u.UpVotes FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.Id = c.UserId WHERE c.Text = 'fine, you win :)';
SELECT p.Id AS PostId, c.Id AS CommentId, c.Text AS CommentText FROM posts p LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id WHERE p.Title = 'Group differences on a five point Likert item';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS dc_superhero_count FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_superheroes FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';
SELECT DISTINCT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id JOIN superpower p ON p.id = hp.power_id WHERE p.power_name = 'Adaptation'
SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id WHERE s.full_name = 'Hunter Zolomon'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ha.hero_id) AS hero_count
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
    SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
    FROM hero_attribute ha2
    JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id
    WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  );
SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS green_villain_count FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE c.colour = 'Green' AND a.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT g.gender, s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id JOIN superpower p ON p.id = hp.power_id JOIN gender g ON g.id = s.gender_id WHERE p.power_name = 'Phoenix Force'
SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination';
SELECT ha.attribute_value, a.attribute_name FROM hero_attribute ha JOIN superhero s ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Aquababy'

SELECT DISTINCT c.circuitId, c.name, c.location, c.country, c.lat, c.lng FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId JOIN constructors k ON k.constructorId = res.constructorId WHERE k.name = 'Renault' ORDER BY c.name LIMIT 50;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS races_outside_asia_europe FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.year = 2010 AND c.country NOT IN ('Bahrain','China','Japan','Korea','Malaysia','Singapore','Turkey','UAE','Belgium','Germany','Hungary','Italy','Monaco','Spain','UK');
SELECT q.q1, q.position, q.q2, q.q3 FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 354 AND d.forename = 'Bruno' AND d.surname = 'Senna'
SELECT s.year, s.url FROM races r JOIN seasons s ON s.year = r.year WHERE r.raceId = 901;
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races WHERE year = 2005) AS race_count, name FROM races WHERE year = 2005 ORDER BY name DESC;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.position, r.positionOrder
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE ra.year = 2010 AND ra.name = 'Singapore Grand Prix'
ORDER BY r.positionOrder;

SELECT r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, c.location FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE strftime('%Y', r.date) = '2005' AND strftime('%m', r.date) = '09' ORDER BY r.date
SELECT circuitRef FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit';
SELECT surname FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'Italian';
SELECT c.name FROM constructorResults cr JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId WHERE cr.raceId = 291 AND cr.points = 0;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) AS driver_count FROM results WHERE raceId = 18;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, AVG(CAST(p.duration AS REAL)) AS avg_duration
FROM pitStops p
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = p.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
ORDER BY avg_duration ASC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT driverId, raceId, points, wins FROM driverStandings ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 90;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name, d.nationality, d.dob, r.name AS first_race, r.year, r.date AS race_date FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON res.driverId = d.driverId JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE d.driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY r.date ASC, r.raceId ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pa.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS left_foot_percentage FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE substr(p.birthday, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992';
SELECT team_long_name FROM Team WHERE team_short_name = 'GEN';
SELECT player_name, height FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player);
SELECT COUNT(id) AS num_players FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' AND attacking_work_rate = 'low';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id WHERE l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League' AND SUBSTR(m.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04'

SELECT ta.chanceCreationPassing, ta.chanceCreationPassingClass FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Ajax' ORDER BY ta.chanceCreationPassing DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT pa.defensive_work_rate, pa.date, p.player_name FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud' AND pa.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00'
SELECT ta.buildUpPlayDribblingClass FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id WHERE t.team_short_name = 'LEI' AND ta.date = '2015-09-10 00:00:00';
SELECT ta.buildUpPlayPassingClass FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient' AND ta.date LIKE '2010-02-22%';

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS avg_overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' AND substr(pa.date,1,10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, pa.potential FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);
SELECT L.name, COUNT(M.id) AS games FROM Match M JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id WHERE M.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY L.id, L.name ORDER BY games DESC LIMIT 4;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_outpatient_1997 FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Admission = '-' AND strftime('%Y', Description) = '1997'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS female_patients FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1 AND e."Examination Date" LIKE '1997%' AND p.SEX = 'F'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'APS'
SELECT ID, Date, ALB FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 AND ALB = (SELECT MAX(ALB) FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5);
SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name FROM member m JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE z.state = 'Illinois' OR z.short_state = 'IL'
SELECT location FROM event WHERE event_name = 'Spring Budget Review';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, i.date_received, i.amount
FROM income i
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member
WHERE i.source = 'Dues'
  AND i.date_received = (SELECT MIN(date_received) FROM income WHERE source = 'Dues');
SELECT SUM(e.cost) AS total_expense FROM expense e JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id WHERE ev.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Community Service' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(event_id) AS community_service_pct FROM event WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31'

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name, mj.major_name AS major FROM expense e JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id WHERE e.cost > 100

WITH member_events AS (
  SELECT e.link_to_member, COUNT(DISTINCT b.link_to_event) AS event_count, SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost
  FROM expense e
  JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
  GROUP BY e.link_to_member
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.link_to_event) > 1
)
SELECT m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name, me.event_count, me.total_cost
FROM member_events me
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = me.link_to_member
WHERE me.total_cost = (SELECT MAX(total_cost) FROM member_events)
SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS total FROM yearmonth WHERE Date = '201309' GROUP BY CustomerID ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1
